Repairing this boundary requires a newly frozen statement and registry and cannot be substituted during this proof phase.
blocker: Closing the exact target requires local placeholder-free implementations of the tensor-CSA, stable-equivalence congruence, base and opposite representatives, quotient descent, associativity, commutativity, unit, and inverse packages, or an immutable compatible Lean 4 terminal body integrated into the pinned closure. retry_condition: First reopen the statement phase to resolve the independent-universe size boundary and freeze a new exact target and obligation registry. Then resume only after placeholder-free bodies for the new tensor-product and group-law obligations exist locally, or after discovery of an immutable compatible Lean 4 proof that can be pinned, exact-type transported, and checked without fetching a moving dependency.
